comment: Eighteen of the nineteen parameters have no widget on the panel: the sixteen Min and Max values behind the eight CV menu entries and two parameters that carry the menu links. Only the synth selector can be clicked. The CV outputs are written only while they are connected (TrackerSynth.cpp:88), so an unpatched one holds a stale voltage. The same modulation values are also written straight into other modules' knobs through the Map entries, which happens whether the CV jack is patched or not.
